apps/web/e2e/AGENTS.md:40:On a macOS Docker VM (Colima, OrbStack, Lima, or Docker Desktop) the testcontainers harness needs the socket named on both sides, because the client and the container see different filesystems: `DOCKER_HOST` must be the client-side socket (e.g. `unix://$HOME/.colima/default/docker.sock`, since `DOCKER_HOST` is unset and `/var/run/docker.sock` is only a dangling symlink to Docker Desktop), and `TESTCONTAINERS_DOCKER_SOCKET_OVERRIDE=/var/run/docker.sock` must be the VM-side path that `mix e2e.server` bind-mounts into the Postgres container. Without them the harness fails before any test runs, with `{:docker_socket_not_found, ...}` and then `error while creating mount source path ... operation not supported`.

docs/agents/notes.md-77-- **Build approvals live in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` under `allowBuilds`**, and every dependency needing a build script must be listed `true` there. An unapproved or placeholder entry (`msgpackr-extract: set this to true or false`) makes the root `pnpm install` exit 1 with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`, which in turn fails every mise task that depends on it — `api-gen`, `lint`, `ci` — even though their own work succeeded. Fix it by approving the dependency (`pnpm approve-builds`), not by ignoring the exit code.
docs/agents/notes.md-78-- **Guarding a test on a generated artifact must not `assert true`**: a parity test that fell back to `assert true` when `packages/api-client/src/client/` looked absent passed while asserting nothing, because its `Path.expand("../../../../packages/api-client", __DIR__)` resolved to `apps/packages/api-client`. ExUnit 1.20 only skips via `@tag skip:` (evaluated before `setup`); `{:ok, skip: "…"}` just puts a key on the context and the next `context.generated` raises `KeyError`. Use `DhcWeb.ClientParity.require!/1`. `mise run phx-test` generates the client (`pnpm --filter @dhc/api-client api:generate`) before `mix test`. Prove such a test fails by temporarily deleting an export before trusting it. `apps/phoenix/test/dhc_web/controllers/inventory_items_client_parity_test.exs` is the reference: it derives the operation set from the spec and catches a generated symbol missing from the hand-maintained `packages/api-client/src/index.ts` re-exports.
docs/agents/notes.md-79-- **Paginated Inventory reads project through `Dhc.Inventory.ItemProjection.project_all/1`**, not `project/1` in a loop: the single-item form issues its aggregates per row and turns a page into N+1. `project_all/1` plus `ItemValues.list_values_by_item/1` batch values, container/category summaries, open maintenance, and active loans across the page while producing an identical read model, so the derived label and availability cannot drift between the list and the detail read.
docs/agents/notes.md:80:- **The test harness needs a Docker socket a sandbox may hide from non-`docker` processes**, so `mix test` dies in `test_helper.exs` with `Failed to find docker host: … :enoent` while the `docker` CLI itself still answers — that is the sandbox, not a broken suite, and `DOCKER_HOST` does not help. A **pure** test file (no Repo, no container) still verifies locally by running its real assertions directly: `mix run -e 'ExUnit.start(autorun: false); Code.require_file("test/dhc/…_test.exs"); ExUnit.run()'`. Anything that touches the Repo or a container still belongs to CI — and `phx-test.yml` triggers on `pull_request` only, so run it against a pushed branch with `gh workflow run phx-test.yml --ref <branch>` (then `gh run watch <id> --exit-status`) instead of opening a throwaway PR.

docs/agents/where-to-look.md:37:| Reschedule a Beginners' Workshop, or change the Reschedule dialog | `apps/phoenix/lib/dhc/beginners_workshops/commands/schedule.ex` (`reschedule_workshop` run clause, `reschedule_locked/3`, `rescheduled_cutoff/2`, `rescheduled_contact_from/6`, `clamp_open_windows/2`, `notify_rescheduled/1`) + `workshop_policy.ex` (`kept_offset_cutoff/2`, `kept_contact_from/4`) + `intake_emails/occasion.ex` (`pre_workshop/1`, `pre_workshop_sql/1`, `rescheduled/1`) + `beginners_workshops.ex` (`cutoff_owed_ids/1`, over `IntakeEmails.owing(:pre_workshop)`) + `batch.ex` (`clamp_window_changeset/2`) + migration `*_add_reschedule_count_to_beginners_workshops.exs` + `beginners_workshops_controller.ex` (`POST /api/beginners-workshops/:id/reschedule`, `beginnersWorkshops.reschedule`) + `apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/beginners-workshop/workshops/[workshopId]/reschedule-dialog.svelte` + `console.remote.ts` (`rescheduleWorkshop`) + `lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule.ts` (prefill + warning) + `lib/schemas/beginnersWorkshop.ts` (`rescheduleWorkshopSchema`); tests `test/dhc/beginners_workshops/reschedule_test.exs`, `beginners_workshops_controller_test.exs`, `reschedule.test.ts`, `reschedule-dialog.browser.test.ts`, `workshop-console.browser.test.ts` | ALE-394. `{:reschedule_workshop, id, attrs}` (venue/date/start_time, optional payment_cutoff_date/time and contact_from) locks the workshop, then its open Intakes; at least one of date/time/venue must change (a changeset error on `date`), a moved start must be in the future, the cutoff must stay before the start. Refusals are only `:after_finalisation`/`:already_cancelled` — Batches, windows and holds never block. Cutoff: kept civil offset unless supplied (each half replaces the kept one's). Contact-from: once Batch 1 is out it stays (a different supplied value is `:contact_from_locked`); before, a supplied value must be ≤ the cutoff date (`:invalid_contact_from`), a kept one shifts by the same days and comes forward to Dublin today if it would land after the cutoff date. Open Batch windows ending after the new cutoff end at it (or now, if the cutoff already passed, because a window must end after it was sent). Every open Intake gets `rescheduled` through `IntakeEmails.deliver/5` (`Occasion.rescheduled/1`: `rescheduled:<reschedule_count>`), nobody's state or hold changes. `reschedule_count` also versions Pre-workshop info: `Occasion.pre_workshop/1` and the sweep filter (`IntakeEmails.owing/1`) look for the current schedule's occasion, so the existing cutoff pass re-sends it at the new cutoff with no second sending path and no ledger deletes. Staff stay assigned; each (the actor included) gets a keyed Notification `beginners-workshop:<id>:rescheduled:<n>`, signalled after commit. The dialog lives on the console (scheduled workshops only), prefills cutoff/contact-from with the same kept offsets (`reschedule.ts`, following date/time changes until edited) and warns "This emails N people" with N = seated + asked. |
docs/agents/where-to-look.md-38-| Cancel a Beginners' Workshop, or change the Cancel dialog or the cancelled console | `apps/phoenix/lib/dhc/beginners_workshops/commands/schedule.ex` (`cancel_workshop` run clause, `cancel_workshop/4`, `cancel_entries/1`/`cancel_intakes/1`/`cancel_fees/1`/`cancel_payments/1` (the lock spec), `cancel_intake/3`, which names a `{:cancel_workshop, …}` row of `commands/settlement.ex`, `notify_cancelled/1`) + `beginners_workshop.ex` (`cancel_changeset/4`, `cancelled_at`, `cancelled_by_principal_id`, `cancel_reason`) + migration `*_add_beginners_workshop_cancellation.exs` + `workshop_console.ex` (`cancel_preview`, `cancellation`) + `beginners_workshops_controller.ex` (`POST /api/beginners-workshops/:id/cancel`, `beginnersWorkshops.cancel`) + `apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/beginners-workshop/workshops/[workshopId]/cancel-workshop-dialog.svelte` + `console.remote.ts` (`cancelWorkshop`) + `lib/beginners-workshops/console.ts` (`cancelPreviewLines`, `cancelledBody`, the `cancelled` Now card, `historyLabel`) + `lib/schemas/beginnersWorkshop.ts` (`cancelWorkshopSchema`); tests `test/dhc/beginners_workshops/cancel_workshop_test.exs`, `beginners_workshops_controller_test.exs`, `beginners_workshops_client_parity_test.exs`, `cancel-workshop-dialog.browser.test.ts`, `workshop-console.browser.test.ts`, `console.test.ts` | ALE-395. `{:cancel_workshop, id, %{"reason" => …}}` (`beginners.workshops.manage`; reason optional, trimmed, ≤ 500, `:invalid_reason` 422 `fields.reason`) refuses only `:after_finalisation`/`:already_cancelled`. Locks Beginners' Workshop → open Intakes' Waitlist entries → open Intakes → those people's live Carried Fees → the workshop's open holds and paying payments (one `{:all, …}` per level; every Intake is created and closed under the workshop lock, so the set is stable). Paid → the `{:cancel_workshop, :paid}` Settlement row (the `defer` row's steps with its own notice: Stripe-paid creates a `held` fee from the paying payment, Carried-Fee-paid returns its fee to `held`), check-in discarded, "Workshop cancelled – paid" instead of "Deferred"; contacted → `returned` (standing back to `waiting`, a holder keeps a `held` fee), live hold `releasing`, "Workshop cancelled – unpaid"; both log occasion `cancelled` and write a `cancel_workshop` `IntakeEvent` with the reason (history `command` enum `BeginnersWorkshopIntakeHistoryCommand` = Intake commands + `cancel_workshop`). Staff (the actor included) get `beginners-workshop:<id>:cancelled`, signalled after commit. CHECK `beginners_workshops_cancelled_check` ties `cancelled_at` to `status = 'cancelled'` (`force_status!/2` sets it). Nothing runs afterwards because every pass, `start_payment`, `confirm`, check-in and fast-track already judge `status = scheduled`; a completion on the `releasing` hold is `paid_after_close` (refunded). The console carries `cancelPreview` (deferred = seated, returned = asked, released = asked with a live hold) while scheduled and `cancellation` (at, by name, reason) once cancelled; there is no transfer command — fast-track the holders elsewhere and they confirm. Seeds: `seed.beginners_workshops` adds a cancelled workshop (2 deferred, 2 returned, 1 hold released). |
docs/agents/where-to-look.md-39-| Send an attended person their Invitation (the Invitation handoff), change the Invitable view, or what deleting an Invitation does to a standing | `apps/phoenix/lib/dhc/beginners_workshops/commands/attendance.ex` (`invite` run clause, `invite_locked/3`, `invite_details/1`, `record_invite_refusal/2`) + `invitable.ex` (the cross-workshop read model) + `workshop_console.ex` (roster `standing`, `finalisation.invitations`) + `apps/phoenix/lib/dhc/invitations.ex` (`delete_many/1`, `delete_and_restore_standing/1`) + `apps/phoenix/lib/dhc/auth/capabilities.ex` (`members.invite` includes `beginners_coordinator`) + `dhc_web/controllers/beginners_workshop_invitations_{controller,json}.ex` (slice `beginnersWorkshopInvitations`: `GET /api/beginners-workshops/invitable`, `POST /:id/intakes/:intakeId/invite`, pipeline `:members_invite`) + `apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/beginners-workshop/` (`invitations.remote.ts`, `invite-button.svelte`, `invitable-tab.svelte`, the Invitable tab in `+page.svelte`/`+page.server.ts`) + `workshops/[workshopId]/workshop-console.svelte` (Invite per attended row, `canInvite`) + `lib/beginners-workshops/console.ts` (`invitationSummary`, `standingLabel`, `followUpLabel`); tests `test/dhc/beginners_workshops/invitation_handoff_test.exs`, `beginners_workshop_invitations_controller_test.exs`, `beginners_workshops_client_parity_test.exs`, `capabilities_test.exs`, `invitable-tab.browser.test.ts`, `workshop-console.browser.test.ts`, `console.test.ts` | ALE-392. `{:invite, workshop_id, intake_id}` (`members.invite`) locks Beginners' Workshop → the Intake's Waitlist entry → the Intake and refuses `:not_finalised`, `:not_attended`, `:already_invited` / `:already_joined` / `:not_invitable` (standing), `:person_not_found` (anonymised); the Follow-up never gates it. The console's `finalisation.invitations` counts the attended roster rows by standing, so the "N attended · N invited · N joined" line and the list cannot disagree. Acceptance is unchanged (`invited → joined`, claims the Waitlist profile and Guardian only through `waitlist_id`, never by email). docs/agents/notes.md-77-- **Build approvals live in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` under `allowBuilds`**, and every dependency needing a build script must be listed `true` there. An unapproved or placeholder entry (`msgpackr-extract: set this to true or false`) makes the root `pnpm install` exit 1 with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`, which in turn fails every mise task that depends on it — `api-gen`, `lint`, `ci` — even though their own work succeeded. Fix it by approving the dependency (`pnpm approve-builds`), not by ignoring the exit code.
docs/agents/notes.md-78-- **Guarding a test on a generated artifact must not `assert true`**: a parity test that fell back to `assert true` when `packages/api-client/src/client/` looked absent passed while asserting nothing, because its `Path.expand("../../../../packages/api-client", __DIR__)` resolved to `apps/packages/api-client`. ExUnit 1.20 only skips via `@tag skip:` (evaluated before `setup`); `{:ok, skip: "…"}` just puts a key on the context and the next `context.generated` raises `KeyError`. Use `DhcWeb.ClientParity.require!/1`. `mise run phx-test` generates the client (`pnpm --filter @dhc/api-client api:generate`) before `mix test`. Prove such a test fails by temporarily deleting an export before trusting it. `apps/phoenix/test/dhc_web/controllers/inventory_items_client_parity_test.exs` is the reference: it derives the operation set from the spec and catches a generated symbol missing from the hand-maintained `packages/api-client/src/index.ts` re-exports.
docs/agents/notes.md-79-- **Paginated Inventory reads project through `Dhc.Inventory.ItemProjection.project_all/1`**, not `project/1` in a loop: the single-item form issues its aggregates per row and turns a page into N+1. `project_all/1` plus `ItemValues.list_values_by_item/1` batch values, container/category summaries, open maintenance, and active loans across the page while producing an identical read model, so the derived label and availability cannot drift between the list and the detail read.
docs/agents/notes.md:80:- **The test harness needs a Docker socket a sandbox may hide from non-`docker` processes**, so `mix test` dies in `test_helper.exs` with `Failed to find docker host: … :enoent` while the `docker` CLI itself still answers — that is the sandbox, not a broken suite, and `DOCKER_HOST` does not help. A **pure** test file (no Repo, no container) still verifies locally by running its real assertions directly: `mix run -e 'ExUnit.start(autorun: false); Code.require_file("test/dhc/…_test.exs"); ExUnit.run()'`. Anything that touches the Repo or a container still belongs to CI — and `phx-test.yml` triggers on `pull_request` only, so run it against a pushed branch with `gh workflow run phx-test.yml --ref <branch>` (then `gh run watch <id> --exit-status`) instead of opening a throwaway PR.

1: /**
2:  * ALE-380: Pause / Resume automatic Batches from the workshop console, and
3:  * (ALE-384) Fast-track. Thin adapters — authorize, one generated Phoenix
4:  * call, translate the problem. Coordinators never send a Batch: the system
5:  * sweep does. (ALE-394) Reschedule. (ALE-386) `runIntakeCommand` runs one
6:  * console Intake command — Decline, Defer and Confirm with Carried Fee
7:  * (ALE-388), Cancel with refund (ALE-387), Resend link, Rotate link — with
8:  * its optional note; the console offers only Phoenix's `availableCommands`.
9:  * (ALE-393) `correctAttendance` corrects a finalised Intake to Phoenix's
10:  * `attendanceCorrections` target. (ALE-395) `cancelWorkshop` cancels the
11:  * workshop with an optional reason. Withdraw, Refund credit and the
12:  * failed-refund follow-ups are the refund module's (ALE-421,
13:  * `#lib/components/beginners-workshops/refunds/refunds.remote.ts`).
14:  */
15: import { form } from "$app/server";
16: import {
17: 	beginnersWorkshopBatchesPause,
18: 	beginnersWorkshopBatchesResume,
19: 	beginnersWorkshopFastTrackNewPerson,
20: 	beginnersWorkshopFastTrackWaitlistPerson,
21: 	beginnersWorkshopIntakesConfirm,
22: 	beginnersWorkshopIntakesCorrectAttendance,
23: 	beginnersWorkshopIntakesCancelWithRefund,
24: 	beginnersWorkshopIntakesDecline,
25: 	beginnersWorkshopIntakesDefer,
26: 	beginnersWorkshopIntakesResendLink,
27: 	beginnersWorkshopIntakesRotateLink,
28: 	beginnersWorkshopsCancel,
29: 	beginnersWorkshopsEnrichDestination,
30: 	beginnersWorkshopsReschedule,
31: } from "@dhc/api-client";
32: import {
33: 	batchesCommandSchema,
34: 	cancelWorkshopSchema,
35: 	correctAttendanceSchema,
36: 	fastTrackNewPersonSchema,
37: 	fastTrackWaitlistPersonSchema,
38: 	intakeCommandSchema,
39: 	rescheduleWorkshopSchema,
40: 	destinationEnrichmentSchema,
41: } from "#lib/schemas/beginnersWorkshop.js";
42: import { beginnersWorkshopCommand } from "#lib/server/beginners-workshops/command.js";
43: import {
44: 	newPersonFormPath,
45: 	rescheduleFormPath,
46: } from "#lib/server/beginners-workshops/form-paths.js";
47: import { beginnersWorkshopsManageOptions } from "#lib/server/beginners-workshops/options.js";
48: 
49: const noFormFields = () => undefined;
50: 
51: export const pauseBatches = form(batchesCommandSchema, async ({ id }) => {
52: 	const options = await beginnersWorkshopsManageOptions();
53: 	return beginnersWorkshopCommand(
54: 		beginnersWorkshopBatchesPause({ ...options, path: { id } }),
55: 		{ fallback: "Could not pause offer rounds", formPath: noFormFields },
56: 	);
57: });
58: 
59: export const resumeBatches = form(batchesCommandSchema, async ({ id }) => {
60: 	const options = await beginnersWorkshopsManageOptions();
61: 	return beginnersWorkshopCommand(
62: 		beginnersWorkshopBatchesResume({ ...options, path: { id } }),
63: 		{ fallback: "Could not resume offer rounds", formPath: noFormFields },
64: 	);
65: });
66: 
67: export const fastTrackWaitlistPerson = form(
68: 	fastTrackWaitlistPersonSchema,
69: 	async ({ id, body }) => {
70: 		const options = await beginnersWorkshopsManageOptions();
71: 		return beginnersWorkshopCommand(
72: 			beginnersWorkshopFastTrackWaitlistPerson({
73: 				...options,
74: 				path: { id },
75: 				body,
76: 			}),
77: 			{
78: 				fallback: "Could not add this person to this workshop",
79: 				formPath: noFormFields,
80: 			},
81: 		);
82: 	},
83: );
84: 
85: export const fastTrackNewPerson = form(
86: 	fastTrackNewPersonSchema,
87: 	async ({ id, body }) => {
88: 		const options = await beginnersWorkshopsManageOptions();
89: 		return beginnersWorkshopCommand(
90: 			beginnersWorkshopFastTrackNewPerson({ ...options, path: { id }, body }),
91: 			{

97: );

100: export const rescheduleWorkshop = form(

104: 		return beginnersWorkshopCommand(
105: 			beginnersWorkshopsReschedule({ ...options, path: { id }, body }),

+import type {
+	BeginnersWorkshop,
+	BeginnersWorkshopDestinationRequest,
+	BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest,
+} from "@dhc/api-client";
+
+/** The command selected after the server has read the current workshop. */
+export type RescheduleOperation =
+	| { kind: "enrich"; body: BeginnersWorkshopDestinationRequest }
+	| { kind: "reschedule"; body: BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest };
+
+/**
+ * Chooses the endpoint for the Reschedule form from Phoenix's current view.
+ * A changed cutoff or offers-start date remains a reschedule request, so it
+ * cannot be silently discarded by the destination endpoint.
+ */
+export function rescheduleOperation(
+	current: BeginnersWorkshop,
+	body: BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest,
+): RescheduleOperation {
+	const unchanged =
+		body.venue?.trim() === current.venue &&
+		body.date === current.date &&
+		body.startTime === current.startTime &&
+		body.endTime === current.endTime &&
+		(body.paymentCutoffDate ?? current.paymentCutoffDate) ===
+			current.paymentCutoffDate &&
+		(body.paymentCutoffTime ?? current.paymentCutoffTime) ===
+			current.paymentCutoffTime &&
+		(body.contactFromDate ?? current.contactFromDate) === current.contactFromDate;
+
+	return unchanged
+		? {
+				kind: "enrich",
+				body: {
+					destinationName: body.destinationName,
+					destinationAddress: body.destinationAddress,
+					directionsUrl: body.directionsUrl,
+				},
+			}
+		: { kind: "reschedule", body };
+}

+import type {
+	BeginnersWorkshop,
+	BeginnersWorkshopDestinationRequest,
+	BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest,
+} from "@dhc/api-client";
+
+/** The command selected after the server has read the current workshop. */
+export type RescheduleOperation =
+	| { kind: "enrich"; body: BeginnersWorkshopDestinationRequest }
+	| { kind: "reschedule"; body: BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest };
+
+/**
+ * Chooses the endpoint for the Reschedule form from Phoenix's current view.
+ * A changed cutoff or offers-start date remains a reschedule request, so it
+ * cannot be silently discarded by the destination endpoint.
+ */
+export function rescheduleOperation(
+	current: BeginnersWorkshop,
+	body: BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest,
+): RescheduleOperation {
+	const unchanged =
+		body.venue?.trim() === current.venue &&
+		body.date === current.date &&
+		body.startTime === current.startTime &&
+		body.endTime === current.endTime &&
+		(body.paymentCutoffDate ?? current.paymentCutoffDate) ===
+			current.paymentCutoffDate &&
+		(body.paymentCutoffTime ?? current.paymentCutoffTime) ===
+			current.paymentCutoffTime &&
+		(body.contactFromDate ?? current.contactFromDate) === current.contactFromDate;
+
+	return unchanged
+		? {
+				kind: "enrich",
+				body: {
+					destinationName: body.destinationName,
+					destinationAddress: body.destinationAddress,
+					directionsUrl: body.directionsUrl,
+				},
+			}
+		: { kind: "reschedule", body };
+}

+import type {
+	BeginnersWorkshop,
+	BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest,
+} from "@dhc/api-client";
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { rescheduleOperation } from "#lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule-operation.js";
+
+const workshop = {
+	id: "6d9e6110-fc8c-4dcf-b64f-000000000001",
+	status: "scheduled",
+	venue: "St. Andrew's Hall",
+	date: "2026-11-14",
+	startTime: "18:30",
+	endTime: "20:30",
+	capacity: 16,
+	feeCents: 4000,
+	paymentCutoff: "2026-11-11T18:30:00Z",
+	paymentCutoffDate: "2026-11-11",
+	paymentCutoffTime: "18:30",
+	contactFromDate: "2026-10-20",
+	contactFromEditable: true,
+	paymentWindowDays: 7,
+	stage: "window_open",
+	seats: { capacity: 16, paid: 1, holds: 0, free: 15, attended: 0, noShow: 0 },
+	alerts: [],
+	staff: { coach: null, assistants: [] },
+} satisfies BeginnersWorkshop;
+
+const unchangedSchedule = {
+	venue: workshop.venue,
+	date: workshop.date,
+	startTime: workshop.startTime,
+	endTime: workshop.endTime,
+	paymentCutoffDate: workshop.paymentCutoffDate,
+	paymentCutoffTime: workshop.paymentCutoffTime,
+	contactFromDate: workshop.contactFromDate,
+} satisfies BeginnersWorkshopRescheduleRequest;
+
+describe("rescheduleOperation", () => {
+	it("sends unchanged schedule values with destination changes to enrichment", () => {
+		expect(
+			rescheduleOperation(workshop, {
+				...unchangedSchedule,
+				destinationName: "National Basketball Arena",
+			}),
+		).toEqual({
+			kind: "enrich",
+			body: {
+				destinationName: "National Basketball Arena",
+				destinationAddress: undefined,
+				directionsUrl: undefined,
+			},
+		});
+	});
+
+	it.each([
+		["date", "2026-11-21"],
+		["payment cutoff", "2026-11-10"],
+		["offers start", "2026-10-21"],
+	] as const)("keeps a changed %s on the reschedule endpoint", (field, value) => {
+		const body =
+			field === "date"
+				? { ...unchangedSchedule, date: value }
+				: field === "payment cutoff"
+					? { ...unchangedSchedule, paymentCutoffDate: value }
+					: { ...unchangedSchedule, contactFromDate: value };
+
+		expect(rescheduleOperation(workshop, body).kind).toBe("reschedule");
+	});
+});

DECLARE
  failures text;
  notification_owner_column text;
  notification_orphans bigint;
  history_rows bigint := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'notifications' AND column_name = 'user_id'
    ) THEN 'user_id'
    ELSE 'principal_id'
  END INTO notification_owner_column;

  EXECUTE format(
    'SELECT count(*) FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN principals p ON p.id = n.%I WHERE p.id IS NULL',
    notification_owner_column
  ) INTO notification_orphans;

  IF to_regclass('public.waitlist_status_history') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO history_rows FROM waitlist_status_history;
  END IF;

  SELECT string_agg(gate || '=' || count, ', ' ORDER BY gate)
  INTO failures
  FROM (
    SELECT 'notifications_without_principal' AS gate, notification_orphans::text AS count
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user_profiles.is_active', count(*)::text FROM user_profiles WHERE is_active IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user_profiles.social_media_consent', count(*)::text FROM user_profiles WHERE social_media_consent IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'waitlist.initial_registration_date', count(*)::text FROM waitlist WHERE initial_registration_date IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'waitlist.last_status_change', count(*)::text FROM waitlist WHERE last_status_change IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.is_public', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE is_public IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.status', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE status IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.announce_discord', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE announce_discord IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.announce_email', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE announce_email IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'member_profiles.membership_dates', count(*)::text FROM member_profiles WHERE membership_end_date < membership_start_date
    UNION ALL SELECT 'notifications.read_at', count(*)::text FROM notifications WHERE read_at < created_at
    UNION ALL SELECT 'invitation_processing_logs.counts', count(*)::text FROM invitation_processing_logs WHERE total_count < 0 OR success_count < 0 OR failure_count < 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'waitlist_status_history', history_rows::text
  ) gates
  WHERE count <> '0';

  IF failures IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Required-field data gate failed: %', failures;
  END IF;
END
$$

DECLARE
  failures text;
  notification_owner_column text;
  notification_orphans bigint;
  history_rows bigint := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'notifications' AND column_name = 'user_id'
    ) THEN 'user_id'
    ELSE 'principal_id'
  END INTO notification_owner_column;

  EXECUTE format(
    'SELECT count(*) FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN principals p ON p.id = n.%I WHERE p.id IS NULL',
    notification_owner_column
  ) INTO notification_orphans;

  IF to_regclass('public.waitlist_status_history') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO history_rows FROM waitlist_status_history;
  END IF;

  SELECT string_agg(gate || '=' || count, ', ' ORDER BY gate)
  INTO failures
  FROM (
    SELECT 'notifications_without_principal' AS gate, notification_orphans::text AS count
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user_profiles.is_active', count(*)::text FROM user_profiles WHERE is_active IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user_profiles.social_media_consent', count(*)::text FROM user_profiles WHERE social_media_consent IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'waitlist.initial_registration_date', count(*)::text FROM waitlist WHERE initial_registration_date IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'waitlist.last_status_change', count(*)::text FROM waitlist WHERE last_status_change IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.is_public', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE is_public IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.status', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE status IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.announce_discord', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE announce_discord IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'club_activities.announce_email', count(*)::text FROM club_activities WHERE announce_email IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'member_profiles.membership_dates', count(*)::text FROM member_profiles WHERE membership_end_date < membership_start_date
    UNION ALL SELECT 'notifications.read_at', count(*)::text FROM notifications WHERE read_at < created_at
    UNION ALL SELECT 'invitation_processing_logs.counts', count(*)::text FROM invitation_processing_logs WHERE total_count < 0 OR success_count < 0 OR failure_count < 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'waitlist_status_history', history_rows::text
  ) gates
  WHERE count <> '0';

  IF failures IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Required-field data gate failed: %', failures;
  END IF;
END
$$

## Objective
- Complete ALE-441: route unchanged reschedule-form submissions with destination edits to the distinct enrichment endpoint, while preserving genuine reschedules and race safety.

## Requirements
- Do not send destination-only updates through `reschedule_workshop`.
- Choose the endpoint from an authoritative server-side read or equivalent.
- Server must still reject false reschedules.
- Do not silently ignore Payment Cutoff or contact-from changes.
- Use documented Colima Docker env for Phoenix tests.
- Restrict scope; avoid unrelated files.

## Decisions
- Reverted the incorrect Phoenix-side delegation from `reschedule_workshop` to enrichment.
- Added a web-side pure selector, `rescheduleOperation`, fed by an authoritative `beginnersWorkshopsConsole` server read.
- The selector chooses `beginnersWorkshopsEnrichDestination` only when all schedule fields, cutoff, and contact-from values match Phoenix’s current view; otherwise it uses `beginnersWorkshopsReschedule`.
- The dialog toast now reports “Destination details saved” for enrichment and “Workshop rescheduled” for a genuine move.

## Work State
### Completed
- Restored Phoenix `require_a_move/2`, preserving false-reschedule rejection.
- Added `apps/web/src/lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule-operation.ts` and its unit test.
- Updated `console.remote.ts` to read the authoritative console view, select endpoint, and return operation kind.
- Updated reschedule-dialog success toast.
- Focused Phoenix test passed with Colima: `mix test test/dhc/beginners_workshops/reschedule_test.exs` — 15 passed.
- `pnpm check` passed with existing warnings.
- `pnpm build` and `pnpm lint` passed with existing warnings.
- `mix precommit` ran all tests successfully: `3171 passed, 4 excluded`; command exited nonzero because `hex.audit` reported unignored advisories at the start.
- `pnpm format:check` failed only on existing unrelated `apps/web/e2e/beginners-workshop-journey.spec.ts`.

### Active
- Review the final diff and decide whether to adjust pre-submit “This emails…” copy/button wording; current success toast is truthful, but the static warning can be misleading for destination-only saves.

### Blocked
- Focused web Vitest test cannot start: `SENTRY_DO SQLite failed; NOSENTRY database is locked: SQLITE_BUSY (extended: SQLITE_BUSY_RECOVERY)`. Retried twice without cache deletion.
- Full Phoenix precommit exit was nonzero due `hex.audit` advisories despite all checks/tests completing; inspect its early output if required.

## Next Move
1. Inspect focused diffs for `reschedule-operation` and remote/dialog changes.
2. Consider updating reschedule warning/button copy so destination-only saves do not imply emails; update associated browser/unit expectations if changed.
3. Retry the focused Vitest test only if the shared Miniflare SQLite lock clears; do not wipe caches.
4. Report the `hex.audit` advisory failure and unrelated formatting failure rather than changing unrelated files.

## Relevant Files
- `apps/web/src/lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule-operation.ts`: Pure authoritative-current-view endpoint selector.
- `apps/web/src/lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule-operation.test.ts`: Selector regression tests for destination-only, date, cutoff, and contact-from changes.
- `apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/beginners-workshop/workshops/[workshopId]/console.remote.ts`: Server-side console read and endpoint dispatch.
- `apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/beginners-workshop/workshops/[workshopId]/reschedule-dialog.svelte`: Operation-aware success toast; possibly adjust pre-submit copy.
- `apps/phoenix/lib/dhc/beginners_workshops/commands/schedule.ex`: `require_a_move/2` restored; server false-reschedule guard.
- `apps/phoenix/test/dhc/beginners_workshops/reschedule_test.exs`: Existing false-reschedule test passed.
- `apps/web/src/lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule.ts`: Existing warning text implementation if copy is changed.
- `apps/web/src/lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule.test.ts`: Warning text test.
- `apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/beginners-workshop/workshops/[workshopId]/reschedule-dialog.browser.test.ts`: Dialog warning/button expectations.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted and the workspace contains many unrelated pre-existing dirty files; only touch ALE-441 files.
- Documented Colima command used successfully: `mise exec -- env DOCKER_HOST=unix://$HOME/.colima/default/docker.sock TESTCONTAINERS_DOCKER_SOCKET_OVERRIDE=/var/run/docker.sock mix test ...`.
- `colima status` confirmed Docker is running.
- `pnpm test:unit --run src/lib/beginners-workshops/reschedule-operation.test.ts` is blocked before running assertions by shared Miniflare SQLite lock.
